Alex Chen: Hey team — need a last-minute cover ask. Family emergency, I can't be primary this weekend (Sat/Sun). I was primary for the APAC window (00:00-08:00 UTC). No active incidents right now but saw a few elevated error traces earlier in EUG. Can someone flip/cover primary? Sorry for the short notice. @ops-scheduler-bot can you paste the current rota for that window?

ops-scheduler-bot: Current rota for 00:00-08:00 UTC (APAC window):
- 00:00-08:00 UTC: Alex Chen (primary)
- 00:00-08:00 UTC: Devon Rivera (secondary)
- On-call escalation: Pager -> Slack #eng-oncall -> Phone escalations list

Marie Dubois: I can take full APAC primary for the weekend if that helps. I’m in CET but can be awake for that window.

Samir Patel: I can pick up 00:00-04:00 UTC (first half) and do a handoff to Marie at 04:00 UTC if that split works. I’ll be on a flight but have onboard wifi for those hours.

Devon Rivera: I’ll remain secondary for the whole window and be ready to jump in. If Samir does the first half, I can shadow him for the transition and help validate any actions.

incident-bot: NOTE: No active incidents. Recent alerts: increased 5xxs on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 between 09:10-09:25 UTC earlier today, resolved automatically. SLO status: All green. Runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall (see section "APAC weekend handoffs").

Alex Chen: Awesome — thank you all. Quick handoff checklist (paste for reference):

```
# APAC handoff checklist
1) Confirm you can receive pager (run test below)
2) Check /dash/latency and /dash/errors for last 6h
3) Verify dedicated pools healthy: opsctl pools list --region ap-southeast-1
4) If degraded: follow runbook > "Mitigate degraded inference" steps
5) For customer-facing incidents: notify assigned CSMs & set status page if needed

# Pager test
opsctl pager test --user <your-slack-id>
```

Also escalation contacts (in order):
- Oncall escalation: Pager (primary) -> if no ack in 5m -> call "Pager Duty" hotline
- Tier2 Eng: Priya Singh (+1-555-0102)
- SRE Lead: Carlos Mendes (+1-555-0177)
- CTO on-call rota (emergency only): +1-555-0199

Marie Dubois: Quick Q on customer impact: If the /v1/generate 5xxs resurface, which customers should we prioritize? I remember Acme and Nimbus have dedicated instances in APAC. Any other high-touch customers?

Samir Patel: Prioritize: 1) Acme (dedicated GPUS, SLA), 2) Nimbus (high throughput enterprise), 3) Beta retail partners (lower SLA). For Acme we can temporarily route to their reserved capacity or enable auto-fallback to the compatible model variant. Steps in runbook under "Customer-specific mitigations" — short version:
- Check dedicated pool for Acme: opsctl pool status --owner acme
- If unhealthy: enable fallback routing: opsctl route set --owner acme --fallback small-quantized-v2

Devon Rivera: Can someone DM me the phone numbers listed above? PMs are easier for me right now. Also, Samir, will you be able to do the 04:00 handoff even if flight delayed?

Samir Patel: @Devon I’ll DM the numbers. Flight is domestic; if delayed I’ll notify here ASAP and Marie, please be ready to take full window if needed.

Alex Chen: I’ve updated the incident log entry for the earlier 5xx spike and linked the monitors. Leaving a brief note: "Handoff: Alex -> Samir (00:00-04:00) -> Marie (04:00-08:00). Devon secondary entire window."

Marie Dubois: Confirmed — I’ll take full window if Samir can’t make the handoff. I ran the pager test and got the ack. :thumbsup: I’ll also run a quick smoke after 03:50 UTC to ensure the fallback routing is healthy.

ops-scheduler-bot: Rota update: 00:00-04:00 UTC — Samir Patel (primary). 04:00-08:00 UTC — Marie Dubois (primary). Devon Rivera (secondary) for 00:00-08:00 UTC. Changes saved to schedule ID 2026-APAC-42.

Samir Patel: Thanks all — appreciate the pick-up. If anything spikes, first actions: check model health, restart worker group if it’s a machine-level OOM, and notify Priya for customer outreach.

Alex Chen: You’re all heroes — huge thanks. Leaving the thread active for any last-minute notes. Handoff complete from my side, will check slack on and off this weekend. :pray:

Marie Dubois: Safe travels Alex — get some rest.

Devon Rivera: Noted. I’ll be watching for the 03:50 smoke check and will run the escalation phone test if the pager doesn't get acked.

Samir Patel: Good luck team. :rocket:

Alex Chen: Closing the thread for now — will reopen if anything changes.
